{"design":"PLAN (2026-11-02, awaiting Mark; implement after the running .2.26/.2.25 and krmn K1 agents land, since it touches mimi-mls observer and shared hub test fixtures). rohanmahy on mimi-protocol#166: an implementation that requires franking includes 0x0020 as a required Safe AAD component. mimid's hub requires a frank_aad item on every message (hub/submit.rs) but never checks the GroupContext safe_aad list.
1. mimi-mls (owns OpenMLS, so the hub cannot decode openmls::component::ComponentsList itself): an Observer accessor for the required safe_aad component IDs of the current epoch and of the pending Commit's resulting epoch (GREASE excluded, decoded strictly as required_lists does). Minimal surface; no other API.
2. Hub: check_group (room creation, hub/room.rs) refuses a group whose safe_aad list lacks 0x0020 (new HubError variant, e.g. FrankAadNotRequired); hub update (hub/update.rs, before merge_pending_commit at ~452) refuses a Commit whose resulting safe_aad list lacks 0x0020 via the existing refused() path (state unchanged).
3. Regression tests first: room creation with no safe_aad / a list without 0x0020 refused, with 0x0020 accepted; a Commit (from an mls-rs member or a plain OpenMLS client, independent of mimid's committer) changing safe_aad to drop 0x0020 refused, one keeping it accepted.
4. Fixture cascade: tests/common build_group adds (SAFE_AAD, ComponentsList[0x0020]) by default; hub tests whose mls-rs/OpenMLS leaves must then list 0x0020 in their safe_aad list (leaf conformance) are updated; follower_e2e already uses FRANK_AAD_ONLY. Each fixture change is required by the new rule and listed.
No group-creation API change in mimi-mls: Member::create already takes (SAFE_AAD, list) components."}
